summary: Marygold Companies (NYSE American: MGLD) reported that its NZ subsidiary Printstock Products Limited agreed on September 22, 2026 to sell substantially all Printstock business assets to TAG Investments Limited for NZ$2,450,000 cash (approximately US$1,400,000), an asset sale mapped to a US divestiture. TAG must satisfy due diligence and financing within 20 working days; landlord lease-assignment consent within 10 working days thereafter. A 10% deposit (NZ$245,000) goes to Public Trust upon the agreement becoming unconditional, forfeitable if TAG fails to settle. Closing is expected November 20, 2026, with a five-year New Zealand non-compete. Watch condition waivers, stock-take-driven proceeds, and settlement risk.
